purpose: Authenticated candidate list for Partner Finder dashboard
server_rules: Resolve the current user from the authenticated session.
Resolve tenant membership from tenant_members using the authenticated user id.
Never accept tenant_id from the browser.
Return only candidates belonging to an authorized tenant.
Apply search and filters after authorization scope is established.
Use pagination; do not expose an unrestricted full-table endpoint.
Do not return internal service credentials or license secrets.
